mapper.select: select o.ID, o.TITLE, o.TYPE, o.PID, o.PIDS, o.SORT, o.STATUS from sys_org o left join sys_role_org ro on o.id = ro.org_id where ro.role_id = #{roleId} and o.status = 1
SELECT o.ID, o.TITLE, o.TYPE, o.PID, o.PIDS, o.SORT, o.STATUS, o.REMARK FROM SYS_ORG o LEFT JOIN ASSET_ATTACH a ON o.ID = a.ORG_ID WHERE a.ASSET_ID = #{assetId}

select
from sys_org where status = 1 and id in (select org_id from sys_role_org where role_id in (select role_id from sys_user_role where user_id = (select user_id from sys_user where status = 1 and username = #{username})))
select TITLE from SYS_ORG where pid = #{pId} and status = 1
